svg.title: How the radix tree inserts, splits, matches, locks and evicts
svg.desc: Request C shares six tokens with A. match_prefix walks S0 and then a0 and matches six tokens. The path is locked with lock_ref 1. Only c0 needs a new slot, 10.
svg.text: WALKS S0 → A0 · 6 TOKENS MATCHED · PATH LOCKED
